# Set48 independent result-publication reference plan

Draft until the exact core/helper contracts and independent bounds review are
frozen. Work stays in `set48-result-reference` outside Git. No Set48 Go code or
new implementation output may supply expected values. Prior frozen inputs and
independently verified Set47 public evidence are named inputs, not new oracles.

## Inputs and provenance

- Pin the completed Set47 implementation and release/closeout records. Extract
  the one actual saved November28 bout from the immutable public first-run
  evidence, with its original full Card/Seed/Snapshot evidence and both fixture
  View projections. Keep the later conflicted overlay separately. Bind source
  file hashes and exact JSON pointers; never read mutable account databases or
  private keys to make reference inputs.
- Bind the earlier independent Set47 verification report. Recompute its
  source/input/result identities independently using the already frozen Python
  engine and codecs as needed. This inherits admission evidence rather than
  claiming a new proof of external identity, ownership or birth authority.
- Copy only explicitly selected prior Python crypto/calendar/codec primitives,
  retaining original bytes, source hashes and an extraction allowlist. The new
  result recipe uses public scalar2, separate statement/checkpoint domains and
  SLUGRSLT. Do not alter old seed vectors or generalize the old carrier contract.
- Any extra two-result/race/codec source is clearly labeled a structural model.
  A model must never be labeled a newly mined fighter or a live saved event.

## Independently derived expectations

Derive ResultSource, ResultKey, Rules/Pin/Store identities, signed statement,
carrier, BIP143/RFC6979/low-S transaction, txid/full raw digest and unchanged
checkpoint message bytes directly from the frozen contract. Cover key1/key2,
old/new carrier and statement/checkpoint-purpose separation. Use published
crypto known-answer controls as independent arithmetic checks.

Cover absent, prepared, built, uncertain dispatch, acknowledged submission,
inclusion, pre-checkpoint orphaning/re-inclusion, depth59/60/61, checkpoint lock,
historical finality, source conflict and result equivocation. Immutable first
statement/raw transaction/reservation/certificate/history must remain exact.
State models are expectations for tests, not executed disk/account/RPC claims.
Include uint32 dispatch overflow, View-only Check refusing to prepare, a valid
checkpoint retained before depth without finality, alternate-valid certificate
preservation and a same-txid/wrong-witness transaction refusal.
Distinguish acknowledged preparation followed by a definite funds refusal from
uncertain dispatch; a refusal must not claim successful submission or erase
known retained preparation.

Include all public DTO kinds and canonical field order, root v8 marker/install
states, initialization refusal/resume and source incarnation bindings. Codec
recipes cover unknown/missing/duplicate decoded fields, nullability, typed
integer/Boolean boundaries, array/depth limits, canonical escaping, response
LF limits, unused request fields and original-view/date/Bout correlation.
Retain representative values once and use finite mutation recipes rather than
duplicating whole transcripts. Include the independent maximum-shape formulas.
Wire models cover node startup cancellation before/after ownership transfer,
borrowed mining owner preservation, original-view fences, older terminal jobs
versus newer explicit status, and historical public provenance versus forbidden
current credentials. These are finite expectations, not executed process,
account-lease or filesystem guarantees.

Proof fixtures include exact source records, full binary selected blocks and
the bounded inventory of at most512 unique headers with distinct current and
historical paths. At most three deduplicated complete witness-bearing blocks
are retained. Cover the explicit proof-unavailable refusal when the original
funding occurrence cannot be proven on the selected inclusion branch. Producer
models must label synthetic inputs and any non-consensus-valid block fixtures.
Normal Argon expected hashes come only from the prior byte-pinned standalone
Argon helper importing no project code; no new project header hashing as an
oracle. The later actual owned-node composition establishes real funding,
maturity, relay/reorg and canonical observations separately.

## Verification and freeze

Produce an input index, source index, canonical corpus, finite case summary,
README and independent regeneration/check script. The checker verifies every
recipe and reference value and hashes inputs before/after. Run serially under
system and Homebrew Python with distinct hash seeds/timezones. Preserve failed
or reviewed draft candidates before correcting them; do not overwrite a frozen
corpus to fit runtime output. Root and peer review the producer, semantic limits
and reproducibility before committing a reference-only freeze. Go comparisons
and implementation start only after that commit.

Normal release packaging, live deployment, GUI/chooser/portrait/accessibility,
the joint D74 review and production authority remain separate evidence gates.
